# Weights

Download pretrained checkpoints into this folder (not tracked by git).

Expected layout:

```text
weights/
  raft-things.pth
  recurrent_flow_completion.pth
  ProPainter.pth
  i3d_rgb_imagenet.pt   # optional — VFID metric in upstream ProPainter
  README.md
```

Obtain files from the official ProPainter repository instructions (releases / Google Drive links in upstream README).
